name: NoMac
summary: On-demand cloud Mac for AI agents: a real macOS machine with Xcode starts in about a minute, your agent builds and ships an Apple app, then the machine can be deleted. Pay as you go.
description: On-demand cloud Mac for AI agents: a real macOS machine with Xcode starts in about a minute, your agent builds and ships an Apple app, then the machine can be deleted. Pay as you go.

pricing.details: Pay as you go 1 €/hour, billed per minute, from a 9 € prepaid credit that never expires; no subscription. A lower official hourly rate on bigger purchases is also published; both official hourly figures round to the same whole euro, so the cheaper rate is kept in the official (non-displayed) notes rather than shown as a distinct euro price. 7-day money-back guarantee on the first purchase (official). No lasting Free plan was stated. Session (full Mac sandbox) and Simulator (cloud iPhone/iPad) at the same hourly rate.
